**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/03/02 (Wed) 20:51
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The European Blockchain Service Infrastructure (EBSI) is a decentralized platform facilitating secure cross-border digital public services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Verifiable credentials play a pivotal role in establishing trust and preserving users' privacy.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The challenge of securely archiving verifiable credentials for the long term has become more critical.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] This paper introduces a decentralized application designed for the long-term storage of EBSI-issued verifiable credentials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The application utilizes the TR-ESOR middleware, which provides comprehensive recommendations for digital document preservation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The integration of TR-ESOR with various storage systems enhances the flexibility and adaptability of the solution.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The paper complies with ACM and IEEE guidelines for influential computer science research papers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The paper offers a concise yet informative introduction to the EBSI framework and verifiable credentials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The paper delves into the challenges associated with archiving verifiable credentials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The paper demonstrates the practicality of the proposed decentralized application in addressing these challenges.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The paper employs state-of-the-art scientific research methodologies to contribute to the advancement of digital credential management and the establishment of trust in decentralized systems.
- [USER] requested to include the W3C VC standard and the TR-ESOR description in the reformulated introduction.
